title: yummy lazy turkish chuck roast belly
description: Fermented, crumbly Turkish dish featuring chuck roast and low-fat-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a lazy Sunday.
instructions: Season the chuck roast with salt, black pepper, paprika, cumin, and garlic powder.
Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Sear the chuck roast until browned on all sides, then remove from heat.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp of vegetable oil, then sprinkle the flour and cook for 1 minute.
Add the plain yogurt and stir to combine.
Return the chuck roast to the pot and add the double-fry KFC chicken seasoning.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Braise for 2.5 hours, or until the meat is tender and falls apart easily.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve warm with the juices spooned over the top.
